lines.text: Oh! Hello there, dear! How lovely to have a visitor.
Ah, there you are! Come closer, come closer, I don't bite.
Oh. Leaving already? Well. Nobody ever stays for a chat.
Off you go, then. Don't mind me, I'll just hang here.
Ooh, it's dreadfully dark in here. Would you be a darling and light a torch? I can't see my own hands!
Hello? Is somebody there? A torch, dear, please. Something nasty always comes when it's dark.
Oh, that's much better! Thank you, dear. Now I can see my lovely dress again.
Light! Glorious light! You're an absolute treasure.
Oh no, no, no! A creeper! Please, please don't explode!
Shoo! Shoo! Go and hiss at somebody else's portrait!
Eek! Get away, you horrid thing! Somebody do something!
You there, the smelly one! Away from my frame this instant!
How dare you! Do you know how long it took to paint me?
Ow! Hands off the canvas, you hooligan!
Aaah! What was that? Oh, my dress, my beautiful dress is covered in soot!
Good heavens! Is everybody alright? I think I've lost a curl.
Rain again. My poor canvas will go all soggy.
Listen to that rain. Perfect weather for staying indoors and singing.
Oh! Oh my, that was close! I do hate thunder.
Goodness! Thunder always makes my varnish crack.
Oh, you look dreadful, dear! Go and see Madam Pomfrey at once!
You're bleeding all over my nice floor! Do sit down and eat something.
Careful where you point that thing, young wizard!
Put that wand away before you singe my frame!
La la la laaaa! Oh, I could shatter glass!
La la laaaa! Ha ha! Oh, I've still got it.
Good morning, dear! Up bright and early, I see.
Ooh, the sun's up. Time for my morning scales.
Goodness, it's getting dark. Shouldn't you be in bed?
Night already? Off to bed with you, and no wandering the corridors!
A Gryffindor! Oh, how wonderful. Welcome home, my brave one.
Red and gold! Now that's what I like to see.
Hmph. A Slytherin. Keep your sticky fingers off my frame.
Green and silver. Well, I suppose somebody has to wear it.
Ah, a Ravenclaw! Clever little thing, aren't you?
A Hufflepuff! How sweet. You always say please.
